items.text: Added cooldown to livestock flee trigger, improved herd regrouping radius, staggered bull flee rules, and other herd‑mate logic; fixes cows not fleeing and prevents instant deceleration after attacks.
Bull can now kick and charge, protecting the herd and keeping it together under threat; also fixes cows decelerating instantly after movement changes.
Fixed super‑fast acceleration on cows and sheep and added tests for bull and cow behavior to ensure proper fleeing logic.
Fixed null‑reference crash when a livestock animal dies.
Corrected grenade client prediction age calculations and ensured predicted projectile steps use the simulated position.
Refactored grenade prediction code, added support for flares and molotov effects, and moved bake processing to preparation stage.
Fixed missing arrowheads when equipping a pre‑loaded crossbow.
Fixed triangle hatch deployment being blocked by nearby deployables.
Resolved server/client collider mismatches on monument blockers, preventing inconsistent blocking behavior.
Disabled shield compatibility with flashlights to avoid unintended shield‑flashlight interactions.
Fixed "guid is empty" server error that occurred when first dropping certain items.
Critters now follow realistic sleep cycles: rabbits are crepuscular, squirrels are diurnal, and bullfrogs stay active all day.
Squirrel and rabbit interest mechanics have been removed, changing their behavior around players and objects.
Barrel blockers now retain movement-preventing colliders across destruction stages, stopping players from passing through them.
Efficiency upgrade size bug fixed; the upgrade now appears at correct scale.
Introduced overgrazing: livestock can deplete grass, preventing further grazing until moved to fresh grass or a trough; affected animals show a label.
Added analogue accelerate and brake support, mapped to triggers; horn and seat swap buttons added; steering disabled while in UI.
Grenades and thrown weapons now use Rigidbody info for client-side prediction, improving accuracy before the object is removed.
Flare now ignites and can be thrown in third‑person view with corrected spawn offset; idle behavior fixed.

Added cooldown to livestock flee trigger, improved herd regrouping distance, introduced bull aggression (kick and charge) and herd cohesion, plus back‑off timers for stray‑from‑mother/herd and mate searches; herd now stays together in danger.
Fixed cows sometimes not fleeing when threatened and corrected instant cow deceleration bugs.
Fixed a null‑reference crash that occurred when a livestock animal died.
Introduced overgrazing: livestock can deplete grass in an area, preventing further grazing until fresh grass is found; affected animals show a label when inspected.

Added distinct activity cycles for critters (rabbits are crepuscular, squirrels are diurnal, bullfrogs no longer sleep) and removed squirrel and rabbit interest mechanics, changing how these animals react to player presence.

Reworked grenade and thrown‑weapon prediction to use Rigidbody information, improving accuracy before objects are removed; also corrected age calculations and ensured predicted projectile steps use the simulation position, fixing grenade trajectory prediction issues.
Enabled flares to be ignited and thrown in third‑person view with corrected spawn offset.
Fixed deployment of triangle hatches being blocked by nearby deployables.
Resolved mismatched enabled colliders between server and client for monument blockers and fixed a collapse blocker reference error.
Shields no longer work with flashlights; the compatibility has been disabled.
Added persistent prevent‑movement colliders to barrel blockers, keeping them solid across destruction stages.
Fixed the "guid is empty" server error that occurred when first dropping certain items.
Implemented analogue accelerate/brake support for vehicles (mapped to triggers), added horn and seat‑swap bindings, and disabled steering while in UI.

items.text: Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame, preventing unintended damage to players.
Implemented initial control-set support for cars, boats, helicopters, submarines, horses, and trains, enabling distinct input mappings.
Added on-screen toast notifying players that modular cars now have a functional handbrake (max 5 per session).
Increased radiation output of sprinkler systems when using radwater: doubled base output plus a 1.5× multiplier.
Corrected fuse insertion events for clans so multiple fuses inserted during the same container opening no longer trigger duplicate events.
Fixed a race condition that could corrupt items in DisplayBoxStorage, ensuring saved items remain consistent.
Instantiated PaintballColorLookup early to prevent save-time crashes from multithreaded access.
Hardened scope code to stop rare null-reference errors when using a scope.
Added monument blockers to red key-card doors in Underwater Labs, altering access routes.
Fixed Russian Roulette storage logic (CanAcceptItem), updated prefab and localization, and rebuilt the manifest.
Introduced a placeholder milk item.
Added a first-pass squirrel interest mechanic, affecting how squirrels react to player actions.

items.text: Fixed scale override on large rig monument blocker that caused collision issues and added missing vent cages.

Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins.
Footstep sounds now play correctly when players are heavily armored or wearing diving fins while slowed.
Fixed a typo that prevented sleepers from being killed in safezones after a server restart.
Animals will now eat from troughs, prioritizing them over grazing on grass.
Added shearing interaction for livestock.
Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.
Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.
Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.
New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.
Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.
Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.
High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.
